title: Yellowed Quick Turkish Lamb Bake
description: A malty and shaggy Turkish dish featuring tarragon and French influences, this kosher-friendly bake is a quick fix for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: boneless and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, tarragon, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium high heat and sear the lamb until browned on all sides.
In the same skillet, add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Transfer the skillet contents to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with the lamb and french bread crumbs.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the lamb is cooked through and the top is golden brown.
